Asha (sec): Heads up — planning a base-image rebake Tue 02:00 UTC to address CVE findings and trim legacy layers. Need RBAC + KMS sign-off. Target: rebake to slimroot:v2 and cosign-signed artifacts. @Liam can you confirm the ServiceAccount binding and audit-forwarding?

Liam (eng-infra): @Asha on it. Proposed RBAC: create Role 'image-signer' in namespace 'builds' with verbs [get,create,update,patch] on secrets/cosign-key and a RoleBinding to group 'ci-runners'. Any objections?

Ravi (eng-runtime): Heads-up: runtime will need prefix/KV cache invalidation after the rebake. Also we should plan key rotation fallback — keep old cosign key valid for 48h to prevent rollout failures.

Nora (eng-sre): Can we do a preflight at 01:00 UTC? I'll run smoke and verify node drain/undo. DeployBot — please post artifact id when scheduled. :eyes: 

DeployBot: Build scheduled: base-rebake-2026-03-24T02:00Z id=bb-7893. Artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-images/rebakes/bb-7893. Trigger: manual (Asha).

Asha (sec): @Liam please add an annotation 'rbac.redwood.io/bind-to-keystore: "true"' to the RoleBinding so only the signing runner pool can request signatures. Also we need KMS audit logs forwarded to splunk index 'sec-kms' and retention bumped for the window.

Liam (eng-infra): Ack. I'll add role + annotation + KMS IAM tweak. Quick question: do we want software KMS or HSM-backed keys for this run? HSM is more secure but adds signing latency.

Ravi (eng-runtime): HSM for prod images. For staging we can use software-backed KMS to keep build reliability high. Plan: sign staging with software KMS, verify flow, then do prod with HSM and the 48h fallback.

Nora (eng-sre): Preflight checklist (I'll tick off in thread): 1) RBAC applied in staging and binding tested 2) KMS key present + cosign sign/verify tested 3) Old images remain addressable for rollback 4) Rollback playbook posted to runbook channel.

Asha (sec): Adding CVE triage note: CVE-2026-3141 affects musl-linked runtime variants used by some internal tooling — we'll exclude those builds from this rebake until we confirm patch compatibility. Document exclusion list in PR.

Liam (eng-infra): RBAC role pushed to staging: rl-image-signer-staging. @Ravi can you validate the cosign verify step? Example command I tested: `cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebake/cryptoKeys/cosign bb-7893`

Ravi (eng-runtime): Verified locally — `cosign verify` returned OK. Also executed cache purge after a local rebuild: `curl -XPOST https://runtime.internal/cache/purge -H 'X-Rebuild: bb-7893'` — runtime accepted the header and invalidated prefixes.

Nora (eng-sre): I'll run the smoke at 01:00 UTC. If anything flaps I'll post logs here and kick the rollback. My watchlist: kubelet restarts, image pull backoff, cosign verification failures.

Asha (sec): Solid. If no blockers by EOD, we cut over. @Liam please attach a short audit runbook + retention policy (30d) in the PR so SOC has the pickup. I'll notify SOC and compliance. :white_check_mark:
